About us

We started as a small workshop in the old harbour district and grew into a company that ships to customers across the country. Our team designs every product in house, tests it for months before it goes on sale, and keeps spare parts available for at least ten years, because we believe things should be repaired, not replaced. Every order is packed by hand and checked twice before it leaves the building.
